purpose: Select the small Story so far roster while preserving permanent story pages.

roster.bootstrap_exception: The first successful selection may admit up to three stories together.
roster.promotion_definition: Any activation, revival, or replacement after bootstrap. Quieting does not reset the promotion clock.

provisional_thresholds.note: V2 uses selected option probability for choice gates, not the separate confidence field. Priority confidence is used only for admission/replacement, never for resolution. Provisional values require evaluation.

precedence: Explicit exclusion prevents admission and removes an active story; a story cannot be pinned and excluded together.
A pin protects an already active story from automatic quieting and replacement, including resolution.
Missing or insufficient evidence that the underlying event exists preserves an active story and defers a candidate. An unknown investigation outcome is not missing evidence of the investigation.
A confidently resolved question can become quiet before seven days, regardless of priority, novelty or follow-up uncertainty.
Otherwise an active story has a seven-day minimum before quieting or replacement.
A material development keeps a story active; an approaching verified event also protects it from quieting and replacement.
Quiet a story after thirty days without a material change, or when its only expected event is more than thirty days away.
Revive an old story only for a material development in that same story; reuse its identifier and page.
Fill toward three with qualifying stories; use the fourth and fifth slots only for higher-priority stories.
At capacity, replace the weakest eligible story only when the candidate clears the priority margin and promotion clock.
New candidates do not require novelty against a historical baseline. Quiet-story revival and stale-story removal still require a usable novelty assessment.
